Hi, I'm **Raagul N**. I build things that sit somewhere between full-stack engineering, AI,
and practical software that earns its place by being useful.

- Currently building **[PHANTOMTRACE-AI](https://github.com/iaamraagul/PHANTOMTRACE-AI)** and **[TrustSphere](https://github.com/iaamraagul/TrustSphere)**
- Portfolio: **[raagul-portfolio.onrender.com](https://raagul-portfolio.onrender.com/)**
- Based in **Chennai**
- Learning deeper **AI systems, TypeScript architecture, and production-ready full-stack patterns**
- Fun fact: **Code is poetry; I just like to keep it concise.**
